current.question: 分析客户价值和销售趋势
current.sql:
SELECT

c."Customer ID",
c."Customer Name",

o."Order Date",
o."Sales",

c."Region",

p."Category"


FROM Orders o


JOIN Customers c

ON o."Customer ID" = c."Customer ID"


JOIN Products p

ON o."Product ID" = p."Product ID"
